current_status.stage: Preclinical/Phase 1 IND targeted within 2026; non-exclusive research collaboration with Eli Lilly ongoing
current_status.partner: Eli Lilly (non-exclusive worldwide license for internal R&D use of SmartDepot; evaluation period extended Dec 2025 to up to 24 months)
current_status.data_point: ~30% body-weight reduction at week 4 in obese-mouse model; Phase 1 human data showed no vomiting/nausea in 16 healthy adults vs. weekly semaglutide (ADA 2026)

finding_history.summary: Peptron presented PT403 (SmartDepot PLGA semaglutide) data at ADA 2026: ~30% body-weight reduction at week 4 in an obese-mouse model, outperforming daily and every-3-day semaglutide comparators, plus Phase 1 human safety data showing no vomiting or nausea in 16 healthy adults versus weekly semaglutide (only mild injection-site reactions). Independently corroborated by a second outlet reporting the same ~30% figure and 'excellent' early human safety/tolerability results.
Peptron shares rose 11.3% ahead of ADA 2026 data, fell ~5% after Eli Lilly announced a separate deal with Camurus, then recovered 6.3% by the conference's final day, closing at 245,000 won ($161).

Peptron shares fell 29.94% to the daily lower limit (111,600 won) after CEO Choi Ho-il clarified the Eli Lilly joint research covers next-gen obesity/diabetes and CNS candidates but does NOT include tirzepatide, disappointing investors. CEO stated the Lilly collaboration "remains on track" with no change in direction; the evaluation period was extended in December 2025 to up to 24 months total. Peptron aims to submit a PT403 IND within 2026 and start construction of its second production facility by September 2026.

Peptron won a construction permit for a second, $60 million (₩89 billion) FDA cGMP-standard plant at Osong Bio Park (~16,500 sqm) to scale production of long-acting peptide drugs, citing its approved once-monthly prostate cancer drug Leupone as proof of manufacturing scalability, ahead of pipeline programs in diabetes, obesity, and Parkinson's disease.
